node: Commercial-grade substrates for 800G and 1.6T optical transceivers
summary: Expanded US-listed universe for the optical-transceiver substrate chokepoint. The strongest direct underfollowed mapping is AXT/AXTI, because it is explicitly tied to compound-semiconductor substrates, especially indium phosphide, and recent external evidence links its InP backlog to AI data-center optical demand. Adjacent chokepoints include Veeco/VECO as a tool supplier for InP laser manufacturing, Applied Optoelectronics/AAOI as a vertically integrated transceiver maker whose InP capacity can become a customer/supplier read-through, and Lumentum/LITE as a high-attention reference anchor for InP laser demand and qualification pull-through. The node remains a hypothesis until primary filings/calls verify customer concentration, exact substrate revenue mix, 800G/1.6T qualification status, and whether the external claim of fewer than six commercial-grade suppliers is accurate.
